scope: Linux opt-in local Access stack; implementation coverage only. See access-a6-independent-review.md for separate independent-review findings, execution evidence, ADR/merge/P8/release gates.

requirements.requirement: One repository has HTTPS, SSH and local locators; editing one leaves its UUID and earlier Core evidence byte-for-byte unchanged.
requirements.verified_scope: Stored HTTPS/SSH/local alternatives and rotation preserve real Core captures. Remote transport execution is excluded.

requirements.requirement: Same locator text in two scopes resolves independently; conflicting UUIDs for the same scoped locator are rejected without merging or overwriting either ID.
requirements.verified_scope: Scoped repository bindings remain unique without URI-based UUID merge.

requirements.requirement: Multiple profiles are reusable across locators; profile rotation does not change locator keys, captures or Source memberships.
requirements.verified_scope: Shared named profiles, transactional revocation and no Core fact changes.

requirements.requirement: A preference for repository A cannot point to repository B's assignment; composite FK attacks and missing parents fail.
requirements.verified_scope: Both preference relationships and damaged-parent diagnostics are exercised.

requirements.requirement: Scope Locators use maximum registration time; equal-time first choices remain ambiguous. No lexical/rowid/arrival tie-break or implicit cross-account fallback. Repository/profile preferences do not inherit this new timestamp rule.
requirements.verified_scope: Maximum registration time precedes permission filtering; repository/profile selection stays separate.

requirements.requirement: Git-only saved access works with no Context; Core-only offline use works with no Access. An imported domain catalog cannot start network work.
requirements.verified_scope: Real local acquisition without Context; offline Core survives missing/stopped Access.

requirements.requirement: Different SSH aliases, scp-relative/URI-absolute paths, percent escapes, `.git`, trailing slashes, IPv6, symlinks, Windows drive/UNC and relative bases retain the declared semantics; unsupported inputs fail without changing files/credentials.
requirements.verified_scope: Finite exact grammar and explicit rejection are tested; this does not promise all Git syntaxes or executors.

requirements.requirement: Malicious helper syntax, shell options, proxy URLs, embedded secrets and import activation attempts are rejected before external side effects; no secrets leak to saved plans, logging, manifests or domain Exchange.
requirements.verified_scope: Reject secret-bearing/command fields before side effects. Not DLP for secrets disguised as prose.

requirements.requirement: Disabling a Scope route retains all registration facts. Removing mutable repository/profile configuration does not delete Scope history, Source known-positive pairs, Core objects/captures or Context evidence.
requirements.verified_scope: Disabling controls revokes grants but retains registration/Core facts. Arbitrary deletion management is not introduced.

requirements.requirement: Concurrent configuration edits cannot combine one version's locator with another version's credentials; request plans, cancellation and retries are consistent and keep original observation identity and cumulative work.
requirements.verified_scope: Single-snapshot plans, CAS settings, original retry intent and final callback admission are tested. No global cross-store linearizability claim.

requirements.requirement: Additional repositories beyond the Core seed can acquire independently without weakening catalog pairing, UUID selection or cross-repository Exchange fences.
requirements.verified_scope: Native, Notes and external GitMetadataInput non-seed acquisition preserves physical Core/Operational pairing; nested repository ownership and frozen original request intent are checked before admission.
gaps: Exchange remains catalog-seed scoped with no Repository-set selector or explicit receiver-target contract. Same-seed R1 onward export is checked; cross-seed R2 import remains refused without mutation. Do not claim complete multi-repository interchange or remove pairing/selection guards.

requirements.requirement: An Access backup made with live WAL is coherent; interrupted/invalid restore is not activated. Continuity preserves Scope UUID/history, but another machine's local execution binding and approvals are not inherited.
requirements.verified_scope: Pinned WAL snapshot and inactive continuity restore; UUID preservation does not import execution authority.

requirements.requirement: Missing/isolated corrupt Access yields honest access errors; proven-sound domain reads still work; a real Core/Context stop is never bypassed.
requirements.verified_scope: Access-local failure isolation and domain-stop refusal use actual acquired Core facts.

requirements.requirement: Context key classification preserves provider facts/observed URLs but rejects transport configuration in ordinary domain Exchange. Historical provenance is not silently redacted or advertised as free of location information.
requirements.verified_scope: Registration contract and exact Exchange envelopes preserve descriptive URLs/provenance.

requirements.requirement: Real-data extraction is opt-in, leaves sources unchanged and reports excluded or unclassified legacy settings instead of guessing or executing them.
requirements.verified_scope: Key-level classification exists; no legacy extractor is implemented and no real-data operation is authorized in this task. Legacy migration is not a prerequisite for synthetic Access acceptance in this unreleased project.
gaps: An optional legacy extractor remains unimplemented. The classification ledger is not an extraction tool; real-data reads/extraction/migration are outside this task.

requirements.requirement: Wheel/sdist behavior, schema/FK/immutability checks and P7 domain backup scope remain consistent at the exact integrated tree; ordinary file bodies remain excluded and ADR 0028 time/trust rules remain intact.
requirements.verified_scope: Exact-tree focused runtime, P7 scope, schema/FK/immutability and separate installed wheel/sdist-wheel smoke are verified in the independent review evidence. This finite implementation check does not accept the ADR, authorize merge or establish release eligibility.

requirements.requirement: Same display name with different Scope UUIDs remains distinct; rename leaves FK/external references unchanged; a URI/URN is never a substitute identity.
requirements.verified_scope: Same labels do not identify Scopes; labels can change without rewriting UUID/history.

requirements.requirement: A(T1), B(T2), A(T3) retains three rows; T3 wins; exact replay keeps row count/time.
requirements.verified_scope: A(T1), B(T2), A(T3) fact-set replay is immutable.

requirements.requirement: Same-time different URIs coexist; query returns both regardless of insertion order and regardless of only one being approved.
requirements.verified_scope: Tied maximum rows remain even if only one is enabled.

requirements.requirement: Clock rollback, late replay and restore never fabricate a fresh timestamp; unknown/invalid/bool/float/string/overflow input receives the reviewed diagnostic.
requirements.verified_scope: Positive original microseconds, rollback warning and immutable replay/restore.

requirements.requirement: Newest unapproved/disabled/unsupported route blocks default execution; it never silently promotes an older approved route. Imported future times grant no trust.
requirements.verified_scope: Newest disabled/unapproved does not enable a historical fallback.

requirements.requirement: Changing Scope route/profile/binding invalidates affected reviewed plans; returning to the same URI at T3 cannot reuse approval for T1.
requirements.verified_scope: Full registration and options/context matching; material updates revoke; final handoff rechecks.

requirements.requirement: A continuing Scope migration preserves UUID and old facts; an independent fork allocates new Scope UUID and does not relabel original S1 history as S2 history.
requirements.verified_scope: Continuity restore preserves all Scope facts; fork creates only new target registration.

requirements.requirement: Backup/restore round-trips every registration, not just MAX(time), with local reapproval; Core offline operations still work without Access.
requirements.verified_scope: Restore preserves complete history, requires reapproval, and does not rewrite existing Git facts.

requirements.requirement: Generic UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE/mutating upserts and Scope-deletion cascades cannot erase or rewrite immutable registration coordinates on supported connections.
requirements.verified_scope: Immutable registration coordinates protected against direct DML and REPLACE.

requirements.requirement: Current request replay cannot silently switch routes after a newer registration; unchanged old intent and cumulative-work accounting remain intact.
requirements.verified_scope: Cross-stage restored retry preserves original plan and accumulates work; fork cannot retarget it.
